name: @adh-sdk/adh-api-types
description: Everything adh derives from the backend's /v1 OpenAPI spec (adhbackend src/adh/openapi.v1.json, served at https://api.agenticdeveloperhub.com/v1/openapi.json): the generated TypeScript response types, the two generators that project the spec into the toolkit's crud + api-explorer packages, and the drift gates that keep those committed artifacts honest.
comment:generators: All three generators READ adh's /v1 OpenAPI spec (openapi.v1.json, a path or URL), which does NOT live in this repo — it is an explicit INPUT, passed as the first argument or via ADH_OPENAPI_SPEC, never a path derived by counting directories upward. They WRITE INTO sibling packages (crud + api-explorer own the runtime halves). The committed outputs are what ships, so a consumer without an adh checkout builds fine; only regeneration needs the spec. tools/codegen/targets.py drives all three as the `ts`, `crud` and `api-explorer` targets.
